map.律师服务收费实行政府指导价和市场调节价，刑事、行政、国家赔偿、劳动/工伤/社保/: Legal fees follow either government guideline pricing or market pricing; criminal, administrative, state compensation, labor, work injury, social insurance and pension cases use government guideline pricing
map.禁止刑事诉讼案件、行政诉讼案件、国家赔偿案件以及群体性诉讼案件实行风险代理；民商: Contingency fees are prohibited in criminal, administrative and state compensation cases and in group litigation; in civil and commercial cases a contingency fee may not exceed 30% of the contracted claim
map.办案差旅费实报实销或包干，一般不包含在律师费内: Travel expenses are reimbursed against receipts or as a lump sum and are usually not included in the legal fee
map.本工具仅供参考，实际收费由双方协商确定，可上下浮动: This tool is reference only; actual fees are agreed by the parties and may vary either way
map.委托律师前，按案件类型（民事/刑事/行政/计时/风险代理）估算收费参考区间。: Before instructing a lawyer, estimate the fee range by case type, whether civil, criminal, administrative, hourly or contingency.
map.财产案件多按标的额分段累计，风险代理最高不超标的额 30%。: Property cases are usually charged by tier on the claim value, and contingency fees are capped at 30% of the claim.
map.了解一审、二审收费的一般规则，便于议价。: Know the usual rules for first and second instance fees so you can negotiate.
map.按各地指导价区间，100 万财产案件律师费参考约 3.5 万–5 万元（分段累计: Under the local guideline ranges, a ¥1,000,000 property case runs about ¥35,000-50,000 in fees, accumulated by tier and varying with region and complexity.
map.基础费 + 胜诉提成，提成一般不超过标的额 30%；如基础费 1 万 + 回款: A base fee plus a success percentage, normally not above 30% of the claim: a ¥10,000 base plus 15% of ¥1,000,000 recovered = ¥150,000, total ¥160,000, within the 30% cap.
